name: game-goat-pp-mcp
description: Look up any game and find what to play next - RAWG search, ratings, franchise order, tag-matched recommendations with remake-aware title resolution, plus IsThereAnyDeal historical price tracking and currency-localised storefront prices, built for agents.

rawg_api_key.title: RAWG_API_KEY
rawg_api_key.description: Sets RAWG_API_KEY for the Rawg Video Games MCP server. Get a credential from https://rawg.io/apidocs.

itad_api_key.title: ITAD_API_KEY (optional)
itad_api_key.description: Optional. Enables the prices and price-history tools (IsThereAnyDeal) by setting ITAD_API_KEY. Get a free key from https://isthereanydeal.com/apps/. Leave blank to use the RAWG-only commands.
